Explore your future career  

As a Staff Software Engineer at Malt, you play a pivotal role in shaping the company's technical direction, architecture, and execution.
 
Staff Engineers are technical leaders who innovate to build solutions that will support the company's growth.
 
This is achieved through individual contributions, applying technical skills to deliver products that will revolutionise the world of freelancing. 
 
Additionally, you provide technical leadership by addressing organization-wide design and architectural challenges and guiding their implementation.
 
Finally, you play an active role in the lead engineering group, contributing to the definition and enhancement of company-wide software and systems engineering standards.

lists.content:
• Lead High-Impact Projects: Lead, plan, and drive the execution of large, complex, and sometimes high-risk engineering projects that often span across multiple teams or systems.

  • Architectural Design: Design, develop, and implement scalable, efficient, and robust software solutions and systems. 

  • Set Technical Vision: Define the short-term and long-term technical strategy and roadmap for a critical area, domain, or the organization's technology infrastructure.

  • Raise the Bar: Drive the adoption of best practices, coding standards, and high-quality engineering processes, including conducting thorough code reviews. Provide architectural guidance and foster operational excellence.

  • Mentorship and Coaching: Provide technical guidance, coaching, and mentorship to engineers, particularly Senior and mid-level engineers, to help them develop their skills and advance their careers.

  • Coordination and Alignment: Act as a "glue" person, coordinating technical efforts and communication across multiple squads, departments, and stakeholders (e.g., Product Managers, Engineering Managers).

  • Influence Engineering Culture: Champion and cultivate a robust engineering culture that prioritizes ownership, excellence, and speed.

• Technical Expertise: You have 10+ years of professional experience in software development, with a first experience in a product company (SaaS, fintech, marketplace…). You're highly proficient in Java or Kotlin, and comfortable navigating complex backend architecture, APIs, and data models.

  • AI‑Driven Innovator: Passionate about AI topics, you regularly keep up to date with the latest developments. You have already worked on AI topics, whether for internal productivity or in a product.

  • Clear leadership: You excel at working effectively in uncertain and evolving environments, managing the interaction between technical objectives and business priorities.

  • Technical Mentor: You have strong technical and craft skills, enabling you to effectively disseminate best practices within the team and provide valuable coaching to “classic” developers or ML engineers. 

  • Product Mindset: You think beyond the code. You’re curious about the “why” behind features, and you're proactive in proposing improvements and owning delivery from A to Z.

  • Resourceful: You always find a way of getting things done, even under severe staffing constraints.

  • Impactful: You demonstrate excellent ownership and problem-solving skills, with a high degree of agency in driving solutions.

  • Strong interpersonal abilities: You possess excellent written and oral communication skills in English (French is a valuable bonus).

• First call with Olivier, our Talent Acquisition Business Partner, to better understand your background, aspirations, and answer any questions you may have. (45 minutes)

  • Interview with your future manager, Jean (VP engineering), to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role. (60 minutes)

  • Technical case and debrief with staff engineers to validate your mastery of technical and architectural subjects. (2h) 

  • Final interview with Claire (CTO) to discuss Malt’s long-term vision. (interview at the Paris office)

🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐
 
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

Explore your future career

You will join the Platform team, the foundational engine driving the Malt marketplace across our backend (Kotlin/Java), frontend (Nuxt/VueJS), and GCP cloud infrastructure.

Your mission is to define and drive the long-term technical vision for that platform: the shared foundations, tooling, and internal infrastructure that every engineering squad builds on, and the agentic workflows that will change how we ship software.

Both matter equally - a strong agentic layer only compounds on solid platform foundations, and our foundations only stay relevant if they make autonomous workflows a first-class citizen.

Either way, the goal is the same: multiply the output of everyone who touches our product, reliably and securely, at Malt scale.

lists.content:
• Set the Long-Term Platform Tech Strategy: Define the 2–3 year technical vision and roadmap for Malt's engineering platform — backend, frontend — alongside platform leads, ensuring architectural consistency, security, and high reliability across all engineering squads. Agentic capabilities are a central pillar of that vision, not a side project.

  • Architect Platform Foundations: Partner closely with Backend, Frontend, and SRE leads to design and build our company-wide platform foundations — from core shared infrastructure through to our agentic layer, consolidating existing POCs into unified, enterprise-grade capabilities.

  • Pioneer Agentic DevEx Workflows: Prototype, scale, and embed autonomous AI agents into the software development lifecycle (e.g., agentic MR reviews, automated code quality, and security fixes) so product teams can focus strictly on core product logic.

  • Deliver Platform-as-a-Product: Provide product engineers with self-service tools, reusable components, clear guardrails, and documentation making both our platform foundations and our autonomous workflows the natural, default way to ship software at Malt.

  • Build, Hands-On: Contribute directly to the platform. You'll write production code on the systems you design: the hardest parts, the reference implementations, the things nobody else can unblock.

  • Raise the Bar: Drive the adoption of best practices, coding standards, and high-quality engineering processes, including thorough code and architecture reviews. Foster operational excellence across the platform.

  • Mentor and Coach: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers across the platform team, particularly Senior and mid-level engineers, helping them develop their skills, master agentic patterns, and advance their careers.

  • Drive Technical Alignment & Change Management: Act as a technical catalyst, influencing and aligning backend, frontend, and engineering leads around transformative AI agent paradigms without relying on top-down authority.

• Technical Expertise: You have 15+ years of professional experience in software engineering, including a proven track record operating at a Staff or Principal level in high-scale platform environments. You're highly proficient in Kotlin or Java, comfortable across GCP and modern web frameworks (e.g. Nuxt/VueJS), and at ease navigating complex backend architecture, APIs, and data models.

  • AI-Driven Innovator: Passionate about AI topics, you regularly keep up to date with the latest developments. You have already built product-grade agentic workflows within the software development lifecycle: systems engineers rely on daily to review, test, or ship code, not demos or POCs.

  • Clear leadership: You excel at working effectively in uncertain and evolving environments, managing the interaction between technical objectives and business priorities.

  • Platform as a Product Mindset: You think beyond the code. Your product is the developer experience: you're curious about the "why" behind the workflows, core components you build, proactive in proposing improvements, and you own delivery from A to Z: including the adoption, not just the architecture.

  • Resourceful: You always find a way of getting things done, even under severe staffing constraints.

  • Impactful: You demonstrate excellent ownership and problem-solving skills, with a high degree of agency in driving solutions.

  • Strong interpersonal abilities: You possess excellent written and oral communication skills in English (French is a valuable bonus).

1. Initial Screening Call (45m): First exchange with Olivier Lachenaud (Talent Acquisition Business Partner) to explore your background, career aspirations, and answer any initial questions.

  2. Manager Interview (60m): Deep dive into your technical background, domain experience, and alignment with Anaïs Ghelfi (Hiring Manager & Engineering Director).

  3. Technical Business Case & Debrief (2h): Practical architecture exercise and debrief with Staff Engineers to evaluate your systems design and agentic architecture mastery.

  4. Executive & Culture Fit Interview (2h): Final conversation with Claire (CTO) to discuss Malt’s long-term vision, followed by an informal coffee chat with Raphaël Ouazana & Pierre Reynaud.

lists.content:
• Think product-first: You’ll work hand-in-hand with Product Managers and Designers to deeply understand user needs, challenge ideas, and co-create elegant solutions. You like to be part of the decision-making, not only execute what has been specced. 
  • Take the lead: You’ll own your features end-to-end. From first sketch to release (and beyond). You’re empowered to make decisions and trusted to do what’s right for the product.
  • Build smart, ship fast: We deploy to production around 70 times a week. You’ll help us keep that rhythm by balancing speed, quality, and business impact.
  • Be a partner, not an executor: You bring strong opinions, backed by experience and you’re not afraid to challenge the status quo when it makes sense.
  • Level up the team: You share knowledge, put in place pair programming when it’s needed, review code with care, and bring others along on your journey. You help raise the bar.

• Frontend: TypeScript, Vue.js, Nuxt, Internal Design System, Stencil.js

  • Backend: Kotlin, Java Spring Boot, Gradle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Redis

  • Platform: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, Gitlab CI 

  • The AI Toolkit: We empower our devs with modern AI coding assistants and are building internal workflows and investigating as many uses as possible (docs, unit tests, migrations)

  • Data: BigQuery, dbt, Looker, Spark, Python

• Remote Culture: Strong remote culture with most of the team working full-remote from countries where Malt has a physical office and legal entity (France, Germany, Spain, Belgium, Netherlands, or UK).
  • Tech Days: 15% of engineering time dedicated to technical project, , continuous training and learning, R&D and technology watch.
  • Tech Conferences: Annual Product, Tech and Data workshop, annual Malt Tech Days, organized and presented by Malt’s engineering team. Opportunity to attend major tech conferences.

• You have 6+ years of professional experience in software development, with a first experience in a product company (SaaS, fintech, marketplace…)
  • You're highly proficient in Java or Kotlin, and comfortable navigating complex backend architecture, APIs, and data models.
  • You have a first experience working with Typescripts and eager to learn Nuxt and Vue.js.
  • You have a “Product Engineer” approach: You think beyond the code. You’re curious about the “why” behind features, and you're proactive in proposing improvements and owning delivery from A to Z.
  • You build with pragmatism: You know how to adapt your practices to the context. You have excellent knowledge of modern architecture, but you also know when you need to move fast and build disposable code.
  • Autonomy: You are committed to improving the team's practices and know how to adapt your methods to suit the context.
  • You own the whole lifecycle: building CI/CD, testing, observability, monitoring. Shipping is just one step. You make sure what you build works, lasts, and scales.
  • Fluent in English, you are comfortable speaking and writing in an English-speaking environment.

• Screening with Alex, our Talent Acquisition Manager, to better understand your background, aspirations and answer your questions (45 minutes)
  • Interview with one of our Engineering Manager, to discuss your experience and the role in more detail (75 minutes)
  • Technical assignment (homecase or livecase, you choose) to prepare and present in order to evaluate your hard skills (90 minutes)
  • Final interview with Jean (VP Engineering) to discuss Malt’s long term vision (45 minutes)
    •  
    We will send you an interview guide so you can best prepare yourself.
